meta.title: E×B Probe Velocity Selector
meta.description: The XHINS-ExB (Wien filter) uses orthogonal electric and magnetic fields to select charge-to-mass/velocity, retrieving ion velocity and energy distributions for Hall thruster and plasma source plume analysis.
page.title: E×B Probe (Wien Filter)
page.lead: Orthogonal E and B fields transmit only ions at v = E/B, enabling precise ion energy/velocity filtering for plume spectra, IVDF, and impurity analysis.
detail.title: E×B Probe System (XHINS-ExB)
detail.tagline: High-resolution ion velocity/energy diagnostics for Hall thruster and plasma source analysis
detail.overview: The E×B selector passes ions with velocity v = E/B through a collimator. Scanning the electric or magnetic field yields the ion velocity distribution function (IVDF). It is essential for evaluating Hall thruster plumes, plasma source beams, energy dispersion, and impurities.
detail.feature1: Direct measurement of ion IVDF and energy distribution
detail.feature2: High velocity/energy resolution to separate ions at different acceleration potentials
detail.feature3: Supports multi-channel acquisition and spatial scanning for Hall plume diagnostics
detail.feature4: Modular design with customizable collimation/flanges/motion stages for easy vacuum integration
